pages.title: M-Theory
pages.text: $(thing)M-Theory$()$(br2)Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): String Theory, Brane Cosmology, Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Quantum String.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Eleven-dimensional gravity compactified on a circle of radius g_s·l_s must reproduce ten-dimensional string gravity. The 10-D inverse coupling 1/(2κ²) = 1/((2π)⁷ g_s² l_s⁸) must equal the 11-D one, 1/((2π)⁸ l₁₁⁹), integrated around the circle's circumference in the extra coordinate y.
